description.ja: • Figure-riseStandard 人造人間編 始動！
• ドラゴンボールの女性キャラとして絶大な人気を誇る人造人間18号を魅力的なプロポーションで立体化！
description.en: • Android 18, which is extremely popular as a female Dragon Ball character, is now three-dimensional with attractive proportions!

description.ja: • バツグンの可動性能！原作で見せた髪をかき上げるなどの女性らしい仕草も再現可能。
description.en: • Outstanding movable performance! The feminine gestures shown in the original work, such as combing her hair, can also be recreated.

description.ja: • 表情パーツは3種付属。無表情パーツを使えばクリリンにキスしたシーンも再現可能！
description.en: • Three types of facial expression parts are included. If you use expressionless parts, you can even recreate the scene where she kisses Krillin!

description.ja: • スカートは軟質素材を使用し、上着は脱がせることが可能。18号の魅力が満載のキット！
description.en: • The skirt is made of soft material, and the jacket can be removed. Kit packed with the charm of No. 18!

description.ja: • ドクター・ゲロによって仕込まれた爆弾を体に内蔵したこだわりの商品仕様！
description.en: • Special product specifications that include a bomb planted by Dr. Gero in its body!

description.ja: • 同時発売の人造人間17号と並べて、劇中の印象的なシーンを再現しよう！
description.en: • Let's recreate impressive scenes from the play by placing it side by side with Android No. 17, which was released at the same time!
